# indykite_knowledge_queries (Data Source)

List Knowledge Queries in the given Application Space, filtered by exact name match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the knowledge queries of a project with the given names.
data "indykite_knowledge_queries" "example" {
  app_space_id = "gid:ZXhhbXBsZS1wcm9qZWN0"
  filter       = ["my-knowledge-query"]
}

output "knowledge_query_ids" {
  value = [for q in data.indykite_knowledge_queries.example.knowledge_queries : q.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_space_id` (String) Identifier of Application Space
- `filter` (List of String) Filter resources based on given names. Using 'exact name match' strategy to find entries.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `knowledge_queries` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--knowledge_queries))
